messages.subject: Caspian — SaaS renewal point
messages.plaintextBody:
James — separate from Redwood: did the Caspian Technologies team come back on the liability cap wording for the Stratton renewal? Daniel chased me yesterday. If it's stuck, let's grab ten minutes after the Redwood call. Don't want it slipping while we're heads-down on the property completion.

Sarah
